name: M7.QualityTable.solve_distance
statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : M7.Action.Recipe N), c.1.card = w → c.2.card = w → (0 : ZMod N) ∈ c.1 → (0 : ZMod N) ∈ c.2 → M7.Connectivity.connected c → M7.QualityTable.solveDistance c = M7.DefaultQuery.distance c
guidance: Use closed_pointwise to obtain its AnswerCorrect field h.2.2.1. Case split actual solve. For none, its first iff gives f=0 and second iff gives actual quantumDistance=none. For some (d,v,k), its actual result clause gives quantumDistance=some d. Unfold only solveDistance/DefaultQuery.distance/Transport.distance; never unfold actual Q or solve internals. This preserves NoLogical as none; no free AnswerCorrect premise. Return tactic lines without leading by.
